summary: Independently reproduced the speaker-echo harness against CURRENT useSaarthiVoice.ts hook. All PASS criteria met: ECHO_DETECTED=false, ECHO_BUFFERS=0, frames_streamed_during_silent_greeting_phase=0, frames_arriving_while_tts_streaming=0, MIC_ALIVE=true (CLEAN_USER_BUFFERS=1). critical_code_review_comments: Echo guards in useSaarthiVoice.ts (state==='listening' && !isPlayingRef.current gate, muted mic sink, cleared pre-roll buffer unless listening, 450ms acoustic cooldown before re-arming mic) are working as designed. No changes needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To re-run: ensure uvicorn mock_voice_server2 on :8000 and vite on :3000, then cd /app/echo_harness && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/pw-browsers LABEL=verify node speaker_echo_test.mjs. Do NOT invoke run_echo_test.sh (it overwrites the hook with a snapshot).
rca of the issue: Original echo bug caused by mic capture remaining active during Saarthi TTS playback + simulated loudspeaker->mic bleed. Fix in useSaarthiVoice.ts gates AUDIO_FRAME emission on stateRef==='listening' && !isPlayingRef.current, mutes the mic sink during speaking, clears pre-roll unless listening, and applies a 450ms acoustic cooldown after TTS end before re-arming mic. Verified: 0 frames streamed during silent greeting phase; 0 frames while TTS was streaming; user speech (post-cooldown) still reaches STT cleanly.
